title: Past Simple — Irregular Verbs
objectives: Use past simple — irregular verbs accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use common irregular past forms.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about past simple — irregular verbs. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use past simple — irregular verbs?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
High-frequency irregulars: go→went, see→saw, have→had, do→did, make→made, come→came, get→got, take→took.

I went to the beach. | She saw her friend.
